description: Full-Screen Gesture Navigation — Replace the thin bottom gesture bar with proper three-zone edge/bottom gesture detection matching Android 14+ stock behavior (edge back swipe, bottom home swipe, bottom-hold recents swipe) with a spring-animated visual affordance on the back gesture.

userStories.title: Add GestureState and TouchZone enums to the shared model
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a single source-of-truth for gesture lifecycle states and screen zones so that all gesture code (handler, visual panel, view) shares the same vocabulary.
acceptanceCriteria: model/SystemUIState.kt adds enum class GestureState { GONE, ENTRY, ACTIVE, INACTIVE, COMMITTED, CANCELLED }
model/SystemUIState.kt adds enum class TouchZone { LEFT_EDGE, RIGHT_EDGE, BOTTOM, NONE }
model/SystemUIState.kt adds enum class GestureType { BACK, HOME, RECENTS }
model/SystemUIState.kt adds data class GestureSession(val zone: TouchZone, val startX: Float, val startY: Float, val startTimeMs: Long, val state: GestureState, val progress: Float)
Existing enums (NavigationMode, NotificationType, etc.) are not modified or removed
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added GestureState, TouchZone, GestureType enums and GestureSession data class to model/SystemUIState.kt; existing enums untouched; ./gradlew compileDebugKotlin BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

userStories.title: Pure zone-detection and edge-exclusion logic in GestureZones
userStories.description: As a gesture handler, I need reusable, UI-free functions to classify a touch-down coordinate into a zone and decide whether a touch should be ignored (exclusion zones), so the Compose view can delegate decisions to testable logic.
acceptanceCriteria: navigation/GestureZones.kt created with GestureZones object
fun detectZone(x: Float, y: Float, displayWidth: Int, displayHeight: Int, edgeWidthPx: Float): TouchZone returns LEFT_EDGE / RIGHT_EDGE / BOTTOM / NONE using US-001 enums
LEFT_EDGE when x < edgeWidthPx, RIGHT_EDGE when x > displayWidth - edgeWidthPx, BOTTOM when y > displayHeight - bottomZoneHeightPx, with edge zones checked first so back takes priority over bottom
fun isExcluded(x: Float, y: Float, displayWidth: Int, displayHeight: Int): Boolean returns true when the point falls in the bottom ~20% of the left/right edge (rotation quickswitch area)
fun isEdgeGesture(dx: Float, dy: Float): Boolean returns true when abs(dx) > abs(dy) and abs(dx) > touchSlop so vertical swipes at the edge are not treated as back
All pure functions (no Compose, no Context) so they can be unit-tested
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: GestureHandler state machine and validation
userStories.description: As the navigation overlay, I need a stateful component that tracks an in-flight gesture from touch-down through move to release, validates it over time, and emits state + progress so a visual affordance and a key-event action can react.
acceptanceCriteria: navigation/GestureHandler.kt created with class GestureHandler taking an onAction: (GestureType) -> Unit callback in its constructor
Expose StateFlow<GestureSession?> for the current session (null when GONE) so Compose can collectAsState
Exposes StateFlow<GestureType?> describing the gesture being tracked for the visual affordance to render the correct arrow direction
fun onDown(x, y, displayWidth, displayHeight): checks detectZone + isExcluded; if valid edge, sets session zone and state=ENTRY; rejects when gesture nav mode is off

fun onMove(dx, dy, totalX, totalY): transitions ENTRY→ACTIVE once drag passes static threshold; sets INACTIVE when user drags back past start; computes progress 0..1 for the back indicator; cancels on multi-touch (tracked outside)
fun onUp(): ACTIVE session past threshold → COMMITTED + emits GestureType.BACK via onAction; INACTIVE session → CANCELLED; then resets to GONE after a short delay
Long-press guard: a handler posts a 250 ms runnable on down; if no move has occurred by then the session is cancelled (mirrors AOS LONG_PRESS_TIMEOUT logic)
Bottom-zone gestures (HOME/RECENTS) are detected in onUp by swipe distance (>80dp → HOME, >150dp with hold → RECENTS) and emitted via onAction
Reads Settings.Secure.NAVIGATION_MODE on construction and refreshes on configuration change; guards edge handling to mode==2 (gesture)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Tests pass

userStories.title: Compose spring-animated back-gesture visual affordance (GestureEdgePanel)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see an arrow appear at the edge I am dragging from that stretches and fades based on how far I have dragged, giving stock-Android-style feedback that my back gesture is being tracked.
acceptanceCriteria: navigation/GestureEdgePanel.kt created with @Composable fun GestureEdgePanel(session: GestureSession?, gestureType: GestureType?)
When session==null or state==GONE the composable renders nothing (zero size so it does not consume touches elsewhere)
Arrow is drawn with Canvas + drawPath (a chevron: moveTo/lineTo/lineTo) and sits inside a rounded-rect background (drawRoundRect) clipped to the correct edge
Horizontal edge: arrow points inward (→ from left edge, ← from right edge); arrow vertical position tracks session.startY with a small finger offset; panel height matches screen height
Arrow length, background width/alpha, and background corner-radius animate with spring(stiffness, dampingRatio) — distinct target values for ENTRY, ACTIVE, COMMITTED, and CANCELLED states
Background alpha fades to 0 on COMMITTED/CANCELLED so the panel smoothly disappears after the gesture ends
Colors read from MaterialTheme so the panel adapts to the system dark/light theme
The composable is self-contained (no window or lifecycle manipulation) — it purely renders what the session describes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Route touches through GestureHandler inside the gesture navigation view
userStories.description: As the gesture navigation view, I want every pointer event in the bottom/edge zones to flow through GestureHandler so edge swipes trigger back, bottom swipes trigger home, and hold-and-release triggers recents — and I want GestureEdgePanel overlaid during active back gestures.
acceptanceCriteria: ui/navigation/NavigationBarView.kt's GestureNavigationBar is rewritten (or a new GestureNavRoot composable is added) to detect drags on a full-height + edge-aware Box, not just the 24dp bottom strip
On drag start (onDragStart) call GestureHandler.onDown with the touch coordinates and the current display size so detectZone/isExcluded run
On each drag delta call GestureHandler.onMove; call GestureHandler.onUp when the drag completes or cancels
GestureHandler.onAction is wired to the existing sendKeyEvent(4 / 3 / 187) lambdas already passed in from the startable
GestureEdgePanel is rendered as an overlay positioned at the tracked edge, fed by GestureHandler's StateFlow<GestureSession?>

Gesture conflict by zone: a touch that starts in LEFT_EDGE or RIGHT_EDGE is locked to BACK for its lifetime (even if the finger later sweeps into the bottom region); a touch that starts in the BOTTOM zone cannot become BACK
Existing THREE_BUTTON mode in the same file is untouched — branches only on navigationMode as before
Typecheck passes
Verify on device using install.sh: flash build and perform edge / bottom swipes to confirm back/home/recents fire

userStories.title: Resize and re-flag the gesture nav overlay window + wire rotation
userStories.description: As the startable, I need the gesture overlay to cover the full screen height with the right WindowManager flags so edge touches reach our Compose layer, and the handler must be re-created or reset on rotation.
acceptanceCriteria: core/NavigationBarCoreStartable.kt's initNavBarWindow(): when navigationMode==GESTURES, the overlay window uses FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE=absent and FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN so touches in the edge strip reach the Compose pointerInput; keeps FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE so the IME is unaffected

Window height for gesture mode remains match_parent width; height is at least the bottom nav height so existing bottom bar still shows, plus the pointerInput layer extends to the screen edges via Box(matchParentSize) in Compose

GestureHandler singleton (from Koin) is obtained once and passed into the Compose tree; its onAction lambdas are wired to sendKeyEvent(4/3/187) and screen-display info is refreshed (display size) in onConfigurationChanged override
onConfigurationChanged(newConfig) is implemented to update the handler's display size and reset the current session so a gesture in flight during rotation does not mis-fire

When navigationMode flips to/from GESTURES at runtime (Settings.Secure.NAVIGATION_MODE change), a ContentObserver re-reads the mode and the startable toggles between the three-button Compose and the gesture Compose (minimal: read mode once on start and log a TODO if it changes — full live handling is a stretch, AC3 satisfied by re-reading on configuration change)
